description: Land Acquisition - Galgedawala, Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition for the Moragahakanda and Kaluganga Development Project. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, possessors, and extents. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
